g.text: Observe scroll depth and engaged time
(10 events, or every 5 s, or on unload)
Take the viewer from the access token, when one is sent,
and attach the country and device server-side
Append to the raw event log
Read events since the last aggregation
Compute views, unique views, read time,
Scheduled, offset to land just after the article rollup
Read the per-article metrics and the social tables
Compute the audience, content and quality rollups
Upsert the three per-writer metric rows
GET the analytics for an article
Read the pre-computed rollup, one row
The dashboards never read the raw event log. Aggregation is
incremental and idempotent, so a re-run cannot double-count.
